balls.text: taken by Hinge!! He turned around, and went forward to end behind the stumps. It was a good catch, with the ball dropping from over his head. It was a short ball from Hinge, and another slower ball. Veer went pulling, but mistimed it. There was no distance on that, he fell off the last ball
pace off, and beaten again. Short in length and shaping away to finish outside off. Veer has a hard pull but misses
forceful loft down the ground. CSK hit 180. Veer is deep in the crease, and has his front leg out of the way. He gets a low full toss on off, and clubs that back
beaten on another attempted slog. Short, and on the stumps. Veer went to pull hard, but didn't get bat on ball
fuller in length, lack of pace, and beaten. Hinge bowls this fullish, and on off, and the ball slightly shapes away. Veer went swinging but missed
quick running gives Veer two. It was a length ball on the shorter side on middle, and Veer swung it towards deep midwicket
now wide outside leg. Slower bouncer on off, but shaping in to finish just outside leg. Veer shaped to pull but then swayed out of the way
wow, that nearly touches the clouds. Angled in, and a bouncer wide of off. Veer doesn't bother
keeps low off a length just outside off. Veer waits, and tickles it late to fine leg
streaky four. Veer has a big loft down the ground off this length ball at a lack of pace, but eventually sees the ball fly over short third

first an overthrow, then a fumble in the deep, and Hosein eventually gets three. Hosein had jabbed this short-of-a-length ball to point, from where Abhishek threw at the striker's end, but wide of the stumps. The miss at deep square leg nearly sent the ball rolling to the boundary, but gave Hosein two extra runs

the ball keeps low, and he's bowled. Sakib can't stop smiling. Dube looks frustrated. Sakib hits the top of middle stump after going for a short-of-a-length ball on leg. It was a slower one too, and it didn't bounce as much as Dube would've liked. He went for the pull, but was beaten by the lack of pace and bounce
wide down the leg side. Slower ball from Sakib, but on a length, and way wide of off. Dube lets that pass
an attempted yorker, perhaps, but this ends as a high-ish full toss just outside off. Dube had a big heave, but missed
and he starts with a four. Beats short fine leg to his right. Sakib bowls a cutter which is short and outside leg. Dube pulls from middle after riding the bounce
good tight line, and high pace too. This one comes at 143kph. Short in length on the stumps, and Veer can only nudge it halfway towards mid-off

bowled him!! Chepauk is stunned. Another one launched at 141kph, and this time Brevis falls. The ball swings in, and lands on a back of a length around off. Brevis goes for the pull, but seemed to have played early, as the ball went below his bat
Malinga fires one at 141kph. Short of a length on off, and punched to short extra cover
ohh, just clears the man at deep midwicket!! That was hit hard and flat. Short and slow from Malinga, and Brevis picks this from outside off to crush it across the line
not quite. He gets a short-of-a-length ball on the stumps, and swipes at it to deep square leg for a single
on a length on the stumps, and pushed down to long-on
the fifth slower ball of the over. This is on a yorker length, and just outside leg. Dube gently pushes it back towards square leg, but Sakib is alert, and forces Dube to rush back

mistimed and lucky, but Dube could get going with this. He attempts to pull at this short ball which is a cutter, and pitching outside leg. Dube gets it off the bottom of the bat, though, and gets four to a straightish fine-leg region
nearly beaten by the lack of pace and the awkward bounce. He takes his eyes off while pulling at this short ball shaping in to finish just outside off. Pulled to fine leg
Sakib keeps bowling at a lack of pace. This pitches short and on leg. It shapes away to finish wide of off, and Dube swats to long-on
yet another dot for Dube. Short in length, and on the stumps. Dube punches but gets it off the outside half of the bat to point
bowls a slower ball at 117kph. Short of a length, and around sixth stump. Slashed to deep cover point
almost a replay of the last ball. Full, slow and wide-ish of off. Dube pushes forward, but to extra cover
dot ball again. Dube drives at this length delivery outside off, and finds the man at extra cover
another slower-ball bouncer, but this is a wide. SRH have no reviews left either. This is bowled in the channel just outside off, and this time Dube lets it fly
toe-ends this bouncer to the keeper. Cummins bangs this around sixth stump, and the ball ends over Dube's head. He looks to semi-pull it, but doesn't get anything
on a hard length again from Cummins. This is just outside off, and Brevis pulls to long-on
Cummins getting the punishment in his last over. Brevis licks this late off his hips, as the ball is on a short of a length but finishing on his front knee. Four to fine leg
over wide long-on. Brevis times it beautifully. Cummins bowls short and around sixth stump, and Brevis waits for the ball to rise before swatting it away for six
short and slow. Around seventh stump, and Brevis rides the bounce to slash it to deep cover point
on a length on off, and punched to long-off
change in length, and change in outcome. Down the ground is Dube's favourite region. Slower ball from Malinga, but on a fullish length just outside off. He clatters it back over the bowler's head
a slower-ball bouncer. The ball has been gripping on this pitch. Malinga banged a cutter on leg, and had it finish over middle, as Dube let it go
a full delivery swinging in, and arriving on middle and leg. Nudged to long-on
short in length on the stumps, and punched down to long-off
slower ball, and that has worked for Reddy. Short in length on the stumps, and pulled calmly to fine leg
Brevis gets lucky!! He tamely pushed his bat at this full and slower ball just outside leg. The ball popped up for a few seconds, but fell short of Kishan rushing forward. A single in the end
bang!! Reddy feeling the heat. The ball is flung over fine leg. Short in length from Reddy, who gets the ball to angle in. Brevis pulls powerfully from around leg stump
slashed to deep-backward point. Reddy bowls this on pace, and short and wide of off. Brevis plays it as late as possible, and gets four
change of pace from Reddy. He bowls this full and on off, and Dube nudges it to long-off
driven wide of long-off. A boundary after a while. Full ball around fifth stump, and Dube drives it hard to beat a running and diving Abhishek
floats this very full and wide of off. Dube doesn't bother about it
beaten!! Great over from Shivang. Angled across, and on a length just outside off. It was too close to cut, but Brevis still went for it and missed
an ugly hoick from Dube. He skips down, but is only able to semi-pull this length ball turning away from him and ending around sixth stump
shapes to take a stride out, but then transfers his weight back seeing the ball is on a length, and wide-ish of off. Hacked to deep cover

chance of a run-out!! But Brevis is safe in the end. He defended to point off the outside half of the bat off a ball which was full and slow, and dipping on off. Brevis took off, but Dube sent him back
tossed up, and it turns out to be a low full toss on off. Driven to long-on
on a full length, and just outside off. Brevis shifts his weight back, and slashes to deep cover point
short of a length on the stumps, and hits his pad as he looks to clip. The ball dribbles to the off side, but Dube can't get a leg bye
slower ball, and another dot. Angled in, and on a fullish length on off. Dube can only push this to cover
starts with a bouncer. Banged in around sixth stump, and left alone by Dube

got him!! Gaikwad's struggle ends. Cummins is turning it around. Finally Gaikwad went for a big shot, but couldn't execute. Cummins bowls it short at this counterpart, and has him pulling from around middle stump. Gaikwad pulled with a full flourish, but found the man at deep square leg
dot ball, and Gaikwad continues to take his time. He flicks this length delivery just outside off, and finds the man at midwicket
punched to deep cover point. Short delivery around sixth stump, and slapped away by Brevis
quick single to end the over. Good one from Sakib. On a fullish length, and wide of off. Cut away to cover by Brevis
pushes his length to go much fuller, but again at a lack of pace. This is bowled around sixth stump, and Brevis drives to mid0iff
the third dot of the over. Short in length and wide-ish of off. Brevis slaps to the man at short cover again
another slower delivery, but this is a wide. Short in length on off, and ending outside leg again. Brevis went to pull but missed

poor line, and six. The ball flies over a straightish fine-leg region. Short delivery from Sakib, who gets the ball to seam back in and finish outside leg. Brevis got the room to pull freely, and dispatched the ball
another dot. This time Brevis reaches out for this short and wide ball outside off, and finds the man at short cover
slower ball, and keeps low as well. A bouncer-length ball around fifth stump, and shaping in to finish on off. Dabbed down by Brevis
Slower length ball on off, he pushes to the left of midwicket who misfields and allows a run
Banged in short on off stump, Brevis takes his eyes off the ball while ducking. He is lucky doesn't hit his helmet, bounces just over

Straight down sweeper cover's throat. Cummins has another and SRH have the dangerman in Kartik Sharma. Slower back of a length ball at 117kph outside off. Kartik had the room but not the pace to work with. He cuts up and over, trying to clear the fence on the offside. He can only swipe it as far as Reddy who takes a smart catch running to his right
On a length on off stump, he pushes to the left of the bowler who gets across and collects
Slower back of a length ball outside off, Kartik throws his hands at it but misses
Length ball on leg stump, he works this neatly to deep backward square leg
Shortish and wide outside off stump, the ball turning away from Gaikwad. He cuts to deep backward point
Tossed up on middle and leg, Kartik pushes to long-on for a run
Googly outside off, he throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies to the left of short third, who dives and saves a few runs

Oh, another run out chance missed. Kartik this time who was well short. Full and down leg, he clips to short fine leg. Kartik is halfway down the track but Gaikwad isn't going anywhere. Kartik was a goner despite the dive but Sakib's throw at the bowler's end is off mark
Googly outside off, he pushes through covers
BANG! Picks up the googly and thrashes that straight down the ground for six. Tossed up on off stump, but right in the slot. He tonks that for a huge six

oof, a run out chance goes a begging.  That should have been an easy run out but Hinge misses. Rising back of a length ball just outside off, he bunts this to the right of the bowler and feels the ball gotten away. He sets off but Hinge sprints to his right, collects and fires a throw. Gaikwad dives to make it back and would have been gone despite the dive
Slower bouncer banged into the surface over that flies Gaikwad's head. That is too high and is called a wide
Banged in short on off stump, he pulls to the right of midwicket who misfields and allows a run
Sharp good length ball on off stump, Kartik pushes back to the bowler
Over the keeper's head now. Not where he intended that to go, but Kartik won't mind. Short and wide outside off stump. He throws his hands at it, gets a thick outside edge that flies away.
PULLED for six! That was flat, hard and went all the way. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, he gets into position nice and early and skims that to the left of deep backward square leg
Kartik breaks free. Charges down the track, makes some room for himself and lofts Hinge inside-out over covers for four
Looped up on the fuller side just outside leg stump. Kartik helicopters that long-on. Six singles in the over
Pushed quicker outside off stump, Gaikwad is happy to work that to wide long-on
Dragged down outside off, but Kartik can't quite cash in. He miscues his pull to deep midwicket
Low full toss on middle stump, pushed to long-on
Tossed up on middle stump, he eases this to wide long-on
Pushed quicker on middle stump, Gaikwad looks to play the pull but only mistimes to long-on
on a length outside off, he pushes to cover-point and sets off. Kartik has to scramble to make it home, which he does.
On the fuller side of length outside off at 140.6kph, he presents the full face of the bat and punches firmly but only as far as mid-off
On a length on middle and leg, Kartik now clips this to deep square leg
Short of a good length ball on middle and leg, he shuffles across and works this to deep backward square leg. No boundaries yet for Gaikwad in the powerplay
Banged in short on off stump, mistimes his pull towards midwicket and sets off
Length ball on Gaiwkad's pads, he flicks this neatly to deep backward square leg
Neatly done. Sakib goes on pace now at 138kph on a length outside off. Kartik dabs that albeit off the cue-end of the bat in the gap between short third and the 'keeper
Slower back of a length ball outside off stump, Kartik checks his punch which goes to cover-point
Back of a length ball on off stump, Kartik stands tall and punches to extra cover

The off stump is knocked back and Urvil is out of here. A third slower ball in a row does the trick. Slower offcutter at 116.7kph that lands back of a length outside off and turns into Urvil. He is through his pull way too early, misses and sees his offpole pegged back
Slower back of a length ball on off, looks that gripped and turned. Urvil mistimes his heave to square leg

Good change of pace first up to Urvil. Offcutter but that was down leg, called a wide. Hang on, we have a review for wide. SRH are already one review down, so this could be tricky. Nothing on the UltraEdge. The balls hasn't touched the bat, glove or Urvil's jersey. And SRH have lost both reviews now inside five overs.
On a length on off stump, he works to midwicket for a run
On a length on off and middle, he mistimes his heave to midwicket
Patel gives himself room outside off stump by backing away. Malinga anticipates well and bangs one short on middle. A good bouncer which Urvil can't do much about
On a length on off stump, he pushes to mid-on and sets off. He had take a detour with the bowler getting in the way, but makes it. No direct hit made it easier
Banged in short outside off stump, he pulls fiercely to deep midwicket for a run
Length ball decking back into Gaikwad on off, he pushes to backward point with an angled bat and sets off
On a length on middle, he clips to midwicket
Oof! Urvil is treating Cummins like he is a club bowler. Shin-high full toss on middle and leg, he shuffles across and flicks this with some power over deep backward square leg

TONKED! A second-ball six for Urvil, that too against Cummins. That is a shot-and-a-half! Banged in short outside off, he is into position early and absolutely cracks a pull over deep midwicket. What a sound that made!
Starts off with a shin-high full toss on off stump, he punches to mid-on

Big appeal from Cummins and Kishan for the caught behind and the umpire agrees. Samson isn't sure and reviews. I think I heard a noise. Let's see. On a length just outside off, nibbling away from Samson, who pushes at it and, yep, there is a clear spike on the UltraEdge when ball is next to bat. Cummins' Test match length does it for SRH and Samson departs for a quick 27. There was a fairly big nick and deflection, so it was a weird review from Samson
Low full toss on middle stump, he bunts to extra cover
Starts off with a a length ball outside off, he opens the face of the blade and steers to deep point
Samson in ominous touch. Short and wide outside off stump, he gets across and thumps the cut to the left of deep point. CSK off to a flier.

Two in two! Oof, the outfield is quick! Back of a length ball just outside off and Samson is rushed in by the pace. He wants to pull and ends up flat-batting that to the left of mid-on and the ball flies away
Short and wide and flayed away. Sharp back of a length ball outside off stump, he gets high up and cuts this to the left of short third

Another one! There is a huge appeal from Hinge for a caught behind but no one else. Oh, wait, Cummins has taken the review despite Kishan asking him not to take it. Don't think Samson got any bat on that. Pacy good length ball outside off stump, Samson shapes up for the cut and gets beaten. Flat line on the UltraEdge and the on-field umpire's decision stands. SRH lose a review.
Play and a miss. A 134.4kph back of a length ball outside off stump, Samson looks for a punch on the up but gets beaten
Back of a length ball outside off stump, he punches to deep backward point for a run

Carved away for four. That is lovely placement from Samson. Cross-seam fullish length ball outside off stump. Samson sees that there is a fielder at deep point, so he opens the face of the bat to place it well to his left to end the over on a high
Banged in short on middle stump, he swivels and pulls with timing supreme to deep square leg
On a length on off stump, he drives on the up to deep cover
Yorker on off stump, he jams this to mid-off
Clipped IMPERIOUSLY! Length ball on Samson's pads and he flicks this away through square way. The Chepauk outfield is lightning quick
And Samson takes full toll. Right in the slot on off stump, Samson gets under it and thumps this down the ground over mid-on for a big six to get off the mark
Rising short of a length ball outside offstump, Samson is up on his toes as he toe-ends to backward point. Oh, hang on, the buzzer goes off. Reddy has overstepped!

goes over point, and a Ravichandran does finish a game off at Chepauk - but against CSK. SRH win by five wickets, with an over to spare. And SRH, along with GT, qualify for the playoffs. Smaran made room, and got a full toss on off. He sliced it aerially, and sealed the win
good inswinging yorker on off. Salil squeezes it out to long-on
short delivery climbing near his throat at leg stump. Pulled to fine leg to get off the mark

ohhhh, Kishan falls!! He's taken at long-off while looking to go for a big hit. He reached out for this fullish delivery arriving wide of off, and couldn't put it away while the bottom hand came off his bat. He departs for 70, having almost taken SRH home
"Two, two, two" is the call, but it's only a single in the end. Good comeback from Kamboj. He bowls a yorker-length ball on leg, and Salil drives to long-off
goes over square leg for another deep six. Kamboj bowls a length delivery on the stumps, and Salil clears his front leg to have a free swing of his arms from deep in the crease
the ball sails over deep-backward square leg. Kishan has turned it around in two balls. Short of a length from Choudhary, and Kishan pulled with a swivel to deposit the ball deep into the stands
crucial boundary for SRH. Kishan reaches out for this length delivery wide of off, and pumps the ball over a ducking Salil at the non-striker's end. This could be a big blow
just short of Dube at extra cover!! Salil swatted this short delivery, which was also a slower one, around off. Dube did look to catch the ball, but it fell short in the end
a Rishabh Pant-like off-balance slap to deep point. On a length, and around seventh stump, as Kishan didn't quite time it well
short in length around middle and off, and punched to deep cover point
another wide. So that's two free runs for SRH despite a wicket first ball. This is on a length, but wide of off. The ball seams away, and Salil leaves it alone
too wide. Choudhary bowls full and around tenth stump outside off. Salil is not bothered

wowww, that seemed to be heading for six!! But Urvil at long-off moved to his right, and grabbed the ball well ahead of the boundary. Choudhary angled the ball across, and bowled on a hittable length wide of off. Reddy went through the line, but got the ball off the bottom of the bat. A wicket and a dot for CSK
dot ball to end. Kishan skipped down the pitch, and Kamboj bowled a full toss wide of off. Kishan threw his hands at it, and got an outside edge to short third
one bounce, and four at wide long-on. Kamboj gets this ball to angle across, and ends up bowling a low full toss just outside off. Kishan hoicks across the line, and gets four
just over the man at extra cover. Kamboj can't collect the throw, and that allows another run. Reddy had sliced it, and just cleared Hosein, before Brevis collected and threw the ball
good ball. Very full, and just outside off. Kishan can only manage to drive to mid-on for a hurried single
a yorker around sixth stump, and Reddy can only swing it towards midwicket off the inside half of the bat

ohhh, great effort from Noor!! He has dropped a catch, but saved five runs at a crucial stage. Great stuff at the fine-leg boundary. He was falling beyond it, and managed to drop the ball back into the field of play. Kishan had whipped this fullish delivery from his pads, and nearly got what he wanted
just short of Veer at long-on!! Suddenly, a lot seems to be happening. Veer was rushing forward to try and catch this, as Kishan pulled another shortish ball from outside off

well done by Urvil at long-off. He ran and dived to his right, let the ball through, but then pulled it back. Kishan had swatted this shortish ball from wide of off after getting across. Nealy a boundary for him
quite full, and on middle and leg. Clipped to deep-backward square leg. Reddy wants a second, but is sent back by Klaasen
Reddy makes a bit of room, and Hosein launches it full and wide of leg. Left alone, and called wide. Great work by Samson to stop that
fifty for Kishan, but he has a long way to go. Short in length from Hosein, and Kishan pulls from outside off to play it on the bounce to Brevis at deep midwicket
spots Kishan get across the stumps early, and fires it full and very wide of off. Driven to extra cover for another dot
a mild appeal for stumping, but turned down. Angled across, and full and wide of off. Kishan went slashing but missed
squares Reddy up. On a length, and around sixth stump. The ball straightens, and Reddy jabs it to point
Reddy makes room... and gets four. Fantastic timing and placement!! This ball is full, and on the stumps, and Reddy drives it to deep extra cover all along the ground
tossed up, and full on off. Driven through extra cover amid calls of "two, two, two". The ball ends wide of long-off, and Reddy even pushes for a third before Kishan sends him back

Samson is thrilled!! Has he really managed to stump Klaasen here?! We'll wait for the final decision, which will come from the third umpire. Noor angled it across, and went on a fullish length on off. The ball turned away a bit, and Klaasen was beaten on the outside edge as he looked to loft. There's no bat involved there, as confirmed by UltraEdge. Ohh, look at that!! Klaasen's back leg is barely in the air when Samson whips the bails off - almost as instantly as the man watching from the dressing room. This could open the doors for a comeback from CSK
crashed to wide long-off!! He makes room, stands outside leg, and launches at this short ball just outside off. It's running away from CSK here
very full, and around off. Swung to long-on from deep in the crease
same ball as the last one, but with a different result. Short and just outside off, and Klaasen finds the man at extra cover
I thought the man at deep cover hardly spotted the ball coming to his left, and hence moved late. Short from Dube, and just outside off. Klaasen leaps in the crease, and slashes it for four
wide for height. Dube bowls on a back of a length just outside off, and seeing the ball fly, Klaasen lets it go
another short delivery at Kishan, and outside off. Kishan tennis-bats it to long-off
much, much fuller this time, and at just 117kph. This is just outside off, and Klaasen drives to long-on
swatted wide of long-off. Not a great line from Dube. He bowls this really short and wide outside off, and Klaasen thrashes it back even as it was a slower ball
forces a bottom edge first ball. Dube bowls short, and just outside off. Kishan looks to swivel and pull, but gets the ball to trickle towards square leg
good comeback by Kamboj. This is a yorker on off, and Kishan squeezes it out towards long-off
slapped to deep point. Short in length, and wide of off. Kishan lets this cutter come on to him, and slashes late
another low full toss, and this one is on middle and off. Clipped to deep midwicket
too high, and wide. Slower ball from Kamboj, who bowls a bouncer around sixth stump. The ball takes off from the pitch, and Klaasen lets it go
low full toss - nearly a yorker - on the stumps. Kishan jams his bat down for a single to long-on
massive six!! On a short of a length from Kamboj, and Kishan heaves liberally from around off to go over midwicket

Kishan had given up!! But there's no direct hit from Noor. He was at extra cover, and moved to his left before throwing at the bowler's end. Kishan gave up well before, and eventually it turned out to be an overthrow after Kishan had swatted a short ball by reaching out
Kishan is content to keep ticking. On a length, and swinging in to pitch around middle. Nudged towards midwicket by Kishan
a late cut off a short-of-a-length ball around off. Single to deep cover point

driven all along the ground to deep point... and they push for two despite the ball rushing to the fielder, who chased it to his left. Full delivery angling in to arrive just outside off, and Klaasen drove that firmly
short in length, and just outside off. Kishan swats this down to long-on after mistiming this ball
whipped to fine leg. Good effort by Noor, as he moved to his left, but missed after Kishan had rammed this ball. It was a low full toss arriving on his pads, and Kishan attacked at that powerfully
a tight line from Johnson. He gets this to swing in, and lands it on a length on middle and off. Punched back to Johnson
ohhh, short ball keeps really low. Noor bowled this on middle, and Kishan had to go low himself to adjust for the lack of bounce. Swiped to fine leg
he bowls full on middle and off, and Klassen sweeps aerially to fine leg
beats Johnson to his left this time. The screw is turning. Klaasen shifts his weight back at this short ball turning into leg, and pulls forcefully for four to fine leg
shot!! This one clears long-off as Klaasen keeps pumping them. He backs away early, and spots this length delivery dipping around off. Launched through the line
shorter side of a length, and outside off. Punched towards deep midwicket
dropped at fine leg!! Johnson was the fielder, and the ball popped out of his hands as he went low and his elbow hit the ground. Klaasen drilled this full ball and went sweeping hard
Backs away and Akeal follows him with a quick delivery which is pushed to long-on by Klaasen
That is a shot and a half! Pushed quicker on leg stump, he backs away a lot and then thumps him inside out over extra cover for a gigantic six
Tries it again, but Akeal has it covered. Fuller on leg stump, Klaasen only mistimes his switch hit to short third
Switch hit comes out and Klaasen gets four. Darted outside leg, he brings out the switch hit and nails it over point
Almost another wicket. Did that carry to Akeal? Nope, just short. Flatter on off stump, Kaasen pushes aerially to the left of Akeal but the ball doesn't carry
Darted on a length on off, he pushes to extra cover
Marginally short, he scythes that to deep midwicket
Top shot! Gives himself a lot of room and thumps a flat Noor delivery all along the turf through extra cover

Ooh, there is a run out chance but no harm done. Flatter outside off, he punches to the left of cover and sets off. The fielder makes a diving stop and Kishan is ball watching. He sends back Klaasen just about in time
Big appeal for lbw, but Klaasen gets a thick top-edge onto the helmet. Pushed quicker angling into Klaasen on off, he  lines up a sweep but doesn't connect cleanly
Darted on middle and leg, he works this to deep square leg
Darted on middle and leg, he pushes to long-on
Flatter on middle and leg, he squirts it off the inside half of the bat around the square leg region
Flatter outside off, he punches to extra cover

Straight down deep backward square leg's throat. Left-armer gets left-hander. And out comes Akeal's mask celebration. Darted down leg, was a nothing ball really. Abhishek sweeps and thinks he has got enough power to clear Johnson. But these are big boundaries and Johnson, right on the line takes a comfortable catch. A very un-Abhishek innings comes to an end
Flatter length ball at 90.7kph outside off stump, he slaps that to deep cover
Not yet, happy to maneuver the strike around. Flatter on his pads, he works this to deep backward square leg
Dragged down well outside off stump, Kishan pulls to deep midwicket

Lots of height and enough distance as Abhishek gets his first six of the innings. Slower through the air but on middle and leg. Abhishek gets under it and lifts it across the line. Plenty and height on it and he clears the deep backward square leg fence as well
Delivered from way behind the stumps and deceives Abhishek. Darted at 97kpg on leg stump, Abhishek wants to tick that fine and misses.
Short and marginally wide outside off, Abhishek misses out as he smacks that straight to extra cover
Flatter just outside off stump, he stays back and works this to wide long-on
Slower through the air on middle, he works this behind square on the legside
Pushed quicker down leg, he nudges this but only to short fine leg
Good riposte from Kamboj. Pinpoint yorker on off stump, Kishan can only jam that back to the bowler
Helped away for a HUGE six! Length ball on his hips, he shuffles across and hammers that miles over deep backward square leg doing some damage to the big screen at the venue
Backs away, gives himself room but can't find the gap. Fuller just outside off stump. Kishan nails the drive but only as far as extra cover
Back of a length angling away from Kishan outside off, he whips it to midwicket
Good bouncer on off stump, he plays a half-hearted pull towards midwicket
Abhishek dances down the track right away but Kamboj fires that fuller and well outside off. Abhishek misses
Low full toss on off stump, he punches to extra cover and takes off quickly for another run
A quick single but Akeal was slow onto the ball. Fullish in length on middle, he pushes to mid-on and sets off. A quicker pick up and throw might have made things interesting
Length ball slanting back into Kishan on middle stump, he defends back to the bowler
Decks the ball back into Kishan sharply from a good length area, cramping him up for room. He defends the ball bowled at 143.2kph
On a length outside off stump, he stays still and drills this on the up to deep cover
BANG! Short and wide outside off, Abhishek throws his hands at it and the ball flies away well to the left of deep point

Oh, that is top placement from Kishan. There is a wide slip in place and a short third but Kishan still finds the gap. Pacy back of a length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat and steers in the gap
Another swipe and a miss. Back of a length ball outside off, Kishan wants to whack that away over the offside but doesn't connect
Flayed away for four. Strays the good length ball down leg, Kishan shuffles and helps this to the deep fine leg fence
Full on the stumps, Kishan presents the full face of the bat and punches to mid-on
Big swing and a miss! Fuller and well outside off stump, Kishan throws his hands at it and is beaten
Edged and four! A slip is in place but the ball flies wide. A 144kph length ball outside off, shaping away. He pushes at it, gets a thick outside edge that goes well to the left of slip
Back of a length ball angling away from Kishan outside off, he cuts to deep point to get off the mark
Big appeal for caught behind, but the umpire stays unmoved. No review too. Short and wide outside off, he looks for a half-hearted cut and misses. Nothing on the Ultraedge
Lands the yorker on point on middle and Kishan just about keeps it out

Straight up and swallowed by Mukesh! Oh, CSK needed that early and Mukesh Starc Choudhary has landed the first blow. Sharp 142.4kph back of a length ball outside off. Head wants to go for a pull, but has to fetch that from way outside off. He only manages a cue-end straight up and Mukesh does the rest. A skip and fist pump from the bowler.
Ooh, uppish but in the gap. On a length outside off, he pushes aerially to the right of extra cover. Not in control but the two runs is what Head will care about

Urvil almost makes a meal of a straightforward save but ends up saving the four. Length ball on Abhishek's hips. He helps this well, almost to well to the left of Urvil at deep backward square leg, who over-runs the ball and just about keeps it from hitting the boundary cushion
Fuller just outside off stump, Head backs away, giving himself room in a bid to access the offside. He can only mistime to extra cover. Good start by Johnson
Length ball on his pad, Head wanted to flick that fine but misses and is hit on the thigh pad
Good length ball just around off stump, he looks for a pull, gets a thick inside-edge onto pad, the ball trickling to the offside. Head wanted a run but is sent back by Abhishek
Edged, no slip and the ball flies away for four. Fuller in length angling away from Head. He pushes at it, gets a thick outside edge that races away to the right of short third
On a length on Abhishek's pads, he flicks to the left of midwicket for a run
Back of a length ball angling across Abhishek, he flat-bats to mid-on
On a length just around off stump, he wants to go across the line, but only mistimes to the leg side for a quick run
Back of a length ball but well outside off stump. Called a wide
Clears the infield and the ball skips away to the fence. Full just outside off stump with a hint of nibble away. He clears his back leg, and lofts him over covers
Banged in short just outside off, Abhishek lets that go and the height is good enough for the umpire to not call a wide
Nails the yorker on middle, he digs this out to the bowler
Not off the middle of the bat, but Abhishek will take that every  day of the week. On a length swinging away from him outside off. He throws his bat at it and carves it over short third
Starts off with a fuller out-swinging delivery on off stump. He jams this to extra cover
